name: Transit Map
keywords: subway metro map wayfinding signage line diagram stations
idea: Wayfinding signage and schematic line diagrams. Each career phase or product track is a coloured line, each milestone a station, and a train moves through it.
note: Live: a train runs the green line; stations grow and announce themselves on hover or keyboard focus.
borrowed: Schematic metro maps (Harry Beck's London Underground diagram, Vignelli's New York map) and transit wayfinding: 45°/90° lines, white station ticks, interchange rings, round line bullets, black signage bands.
mood: Clear, systematic, friendly. Suits timelines, roadmaps, career paths, onboarding flows, multi-track programmes, and conference schedules.
motion: Train: SVG `animateMotion` along the line path, slow and steady (7s).
Stations: hover/focus enlarges the tick and announces the stop in a live region.
Idea: scroll progress drives the train between stations (one section = one stop).
watchouts: Lines only at 0°, 45° and 90°. Free curves break the schematic.
Line colours alone don't carry meaning: always pair with a letter bullet.
Orange text on white fails contrast; orange is for lines, never words.
tokens:
--bg: #FFFFFF;  --ink: #1B1B1B;  --green: #009B3A;  --orange: #F08A00;  --purple: #7D3F98;  --blue: #0074C8;
--sans: 'Overpass', sans-serif;   line stroke: 10px round caps;  station: r 7, white fill, 3px ink stroke
